run_clustering_metrics_evaluation: run clustering evaluation metrics on random uniform labelings to compare adjusted versus non-adjusted scores
test_random_labels: test the random_labels function to generate uniformly distributed random cluster assignments
test_fixed_classes_uniform_labelings_sco: test fixed_classes_uniform_labelings_scores to evaluate clustering metrics against fixed ground truth labels
test_uniform_labelings_scores: test uniform_labelings_scores to evaluate clustering metrics on two random labelings with equal cluster counts
review_clustering_metrics_list: review the score_funcs list of six clustering evaluation metrics including V-measure, ARI, AMI, MI, NMI, and Rand index
